message: ./packages/client[cli] is built from source when installed (it is a local directory), which runs its build code: --only-binary=:all: in requirements.txt forbids building only for packages from an index, and depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Give the requirement a package name (name @ ./packages/client[cli]) so that it can be allowed with "pypi:name" in installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json, or remove it
